overview_description.description:
Ordera is a mobile application focusing on enhancing the pick-up (takeaway) experience in the F&B industry, using Ordera people will be able to place and pay for their orders before their arrival to the venue and pick them up on the go in less than 30 seconds whether from the store or even from their cars like a virtual drive-thru. And with our built-in loyalty program, the more people use the application the more free-stuff they collect from their favorite venues.
On the other hand, Ordera helps venue owners to increase their sales, know their customers, and maintain their loyal ones!
